card.name: Space right before a dose amount
card.fires_on: The blank space or small linking word just before a dose number and mg or mL, after phrases like "provides", "dose of" or "containing". Also fires on "aluminum" in antacid mentions.

modes.label: Before a dose amount
modes.description: The space or "of" right before a number with mg or mL in a dosing statement.
modes.example: Zinc Sulfate Injection provides<< >>1 mg/mL of zinc.

modes.label: Aluminum in antacids
modes.description: The word aluminum naming aluminum-containing antacids in interaction text.
modes.example: after a bile acid binding resin or<< aluminum>>-based antacid.

card.writes: It seems to push toward the start of a number or unit, with little clear effect on the other promoted tokens.
card.plain: It lights up just before a dose amount such as 1 mg/mL is written, and on aluminum antacids.
